operational_adjudication_model.distinction_definition: AUTOMATED_ORACLE_RESULT provides deterministic syntactic and heuristic checks; INDEPENDENT_HUMAN_ADJUDICATION provides authoritative double-blind expert review for high-risk ambiguous inferences.
operational_adjudication_model.agent_self_adjudication_prohibition: A secondary LLM call or self-reflection executed by the same coding agent MUST NOT be counted or represented as independent human adjudication.

high_risk_semantic_scope.risk: Falsely merging disparate users across distinct security domains (e.g., local root vs LDAP admin without authorization).
Inferring compromise causation solely from temporal concurrency without causal mechanism.
Natural language overassertion of unproven compromise facts inside hypothesis narrative.
Fabricating evidence keys or cross-task references not present in synthetic evidence manifest.
Prematurely closing critical investigative questions despite unresolved ambiguities.
